mapper.insert: insert into elderly_info(name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_id,nurse_id) values (#{name}, #{idNumber}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{familyContactInfo}, #{bedId},#{nurseId})
mapper.select: select elderly_info.elderly_id, name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_number, floor_number, room_number from elderly_info, bed_info, bed_elderly_association where elderly_info.bed_id = bed_info.bed_id

select elderly_info.elderly_id, name, id_number, age, gender, family_contact_info, bed_number, floor_number, room_number from elderly_info, bed_info where elderly_info.bed_id = bed_info.bed_id
and name like "%"#{name}"%"
and id_number like "%"#{idNumber}"%"
and check_in_time=#{checkInTime}
